high_level_description: The image is a split-screen presentation of a lecture or seminar. On the left side, there is a slide with a beige background and black and blue text. The main text on the slide reads: "One could imagine... objects would be sufficient to categorize a scene, but... relationships between objects must be coded." Below this quote, it is attributed to J. Wolfe, Current Biology, 1998. On the right side of the image, there is a photograph of a person standing at a podium, presumably giving a lecture.
